description: Makes a folder in Home, at the top or inside another folder. Folders gather a client's or a project's work from every tool. Check workspace_folders_browse first so you don't make one that exists. May return needs_confirmation.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

parentId.description: The folder to make it in; omit for the top.

workspace.description: Workspace slug, for tokens without a default.

name: workspace_folders_create
title: Make a folder
